daily.deja: You already claimed today's reward. Next daily {quand}.
daily.serie_max: Maximum streak reached: keep it by coming back every day.
daily.serie_perdue: Your streak was broken (a day without a daily): it restarts at 1.
travail.refus.sans_metier: You don't have a job yet: pick one with `/travail` (action "Choose or change job").
travail.refus.cooldown: You are still tired: next work available {quand}.
travail.refus.limite_jour: You already did your 8 jobs today: no more earnings until tomorrow, get some rest.
travail.refus.metier_manquant: Give the job to choose with the "metier" option.
travail.pas_a_vous: This button is not for you.
travail.choisi: You are now a **{metier}**. Your first choice is free.
travail.change_confirme: Becoming a **{metier}** costs {prix} and your level ({niveau}) will restart at 1. Do you confirm?
travail.change_ok: You are now a **{metier}** ({prix} spent). Level 1.
travail.texte.forgeron.1: You hammer a blade until it sings under the hammer.
travail.texte.forgeron.2: A customer waits for a horseshoe: you quench it in steaming water.
travail.texte.forgeron.3: You mend the hinges of an old gate, sparks flying.
travail.texte.forgeron.4: The forge glows red; you draw a perfect spearhead from the embers.
travail.texte.forgeron.5: You sharpen a row of sickles before the harvest.
travail.texte.cartographe.1: You survey the curves of a hill and copy them onto vellum.
travail.texte.cartographe.2: A merchant pays you to chart a shortcut through the marshes.
travail.texte.cartographe.3: You fix the compass rose on an old, mouldy map.
travail.texte.cartographe.4: You map a river that nobody had ever named.
travail.texte.cartographe.5: You illuminate the border of an atlas with sea monsters.
travail.texte.herboriste.1: You pick wild sage at dawn, the dew still on it.
travail.texte.herboriste.2: You prepare an arnica salve for an injured woodcutter.
travail.texte.herboriste.3: You hang bundles of lavender to dry in your back room.
travail.texte.herboriste.4: You spot a rare mushroom and sell it to the apothecary.
travail.texte.herboriste.5: You blend a soothing herbal tea for the whole village.
travail.texte.horloger.1: You replace the spring of a clock that had been slow for years.
travail.texte.horloger.2: You oil the tiny gears of a pocket watch.
travail.texte.horloger.3: The town square chime finally rings true, thanks to you.
travail.texte.horloger.4: You polish the face of an ancient clock until it shines.
travail.texte.horloger.5: You adjust an hourglass so it counts exactly one hour.
travail.texte.archiviste.1: You sort a century of ledgers in alphabetical order.
travail.texte.archiviste.2: You find a lost deed behind a dusty shelf.
travail.texte.archiviste.3: You copy out a fragile scroll before it crumbles to dust.
travail.texte.archiviste.4: You compile the index of a forgotten library.
travail.texte.archiviste.5: You decipher an ancient letter for a hurried genealogist.
